whatChanged.theMeasuredDefect: ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 places a widget's appearance by transforming its /BBox by its /Matrix, taking the bounding box of the result, and computing the matrix that maps that box onto the annotation's /Rect. pdf-lib's PDFForm.flatten (node_modules/pdf-lib/cjs/api/form/PDFForm.js) emits pushGraphicsState, translate(rect.x, rect.y), rotateInPlace at rotation 0 -- which is translate(0,0) plus rotateDegrees(0), an identity -- then drawObject and popGraphicsState. The 12.5.5 fit is never computed and never applied. Read back from the delivered base bytes: packet page 5 places FlatWidget-1848524175 at '1 0 0 1 131.309 438.449 cm' with BBox [0 0 18 18], /Matrix [1 0 0 1 0 0] and content '0.5 0.5 17 17 re s', against a /Rect of 14.4 x 14.4 read from the pinned 600-00228. A 17pt stroked square where the Judiciary's form draws a 13.6pt one.
whatChanged.theSharedModule: rcap-active-content.mjs gains one exported constant APPEARANCE_FIT_TOLERANCE_PT (0.05), one exported function fitAppearanceStreamsToRect(pdfDoc, form, { tolerancePt }), and one OPT-IN option on sanitizeAndFlatten named fitAppearancesToRect, default false. When on it runs immediately after form.updateFieldAppearances() and immediately before form.flatten(), so it operates on the streams that will actually be stamped, including any pdf-lib has just generated.
whatChanged.theTransform: flatten() will translate to (rect.x, rect.y) whatever this does, so the mapping is folded into the appearance's own /Matrix rather than into the page. Wanted: content -> Matrix -> A, where A maps the transformed BBox onto /Rect absolutely. Given: content -> Matrix' -> T(rect.x, rect.y). So Matrix' = Matrix x A x T(-rect.x, -rect.y) = Matrix x B, where B = [sx 0 0 sy -bx0*sx -by0*sy], [bx0 by0 bx1 by1] is the BBox transformed by /Matrix, and sx, sy scale it to the /Rect's own width and height. /Rect's POSITION drops out entirely, because pdf-lib has already translated there. For field 15 that is B = [0.8 0 0 0.8 0 0] and Matrix' = [0.8 0 0 0.8 0 0]; the appearance's content bytes are not touched.
whatChanged.howTheClassificationIsMade: By three geometric facts read off each widget: its /Rect, its appearance's /BBox and that appearance's /Matrix. No family, form number, field name, caption, jurisdiction or route is read anywhere in the function, and there is no list of any kind in it. The appearance examined is the one pdf-lib's flatten would place, resolved exactly the way PDFForm.findWidgetAppearanceRef resolves it -- by the FIELD's value falling back to /Off for a check box or radio, not by /AS.
whatChanged.whyItReadsRatherThanEnsures: PDFAnnotation.getNormalAppearance calls ensureAP, which INSTALLS an empty /AP on a widget that has none. A function that changes bytes merely by looking is the defect this factory exists to catch, so the /AP is read directly off the widget dictionary and a widget flatten would itself refuse is counted and left alone.
whatChanged.theTolerance: APPEARANCE_FIT_TOLERANCE_PT = 0.05pt, applied to the maximum displacement of any appearance corner from the widget box, uniformly, in every jurisdiction. It is a geometric threshold and not an exception: 0.05pt is a fifth of a pixel at 300 dpi, so a mapping under it cannot change a pixel, and rewriting a stream to apply it would change bytes without changing the page. The measured case is 600-00228 field 16, whose /Rect is 14.400 by 14.401 against a 14.4 by 14.4 BBox -- an exact scale of 1.00007, which is the form's own rounding. VF02's sweep requires that placement to stay byte-identical and it does. Field 15 is 3.6pt out, seventy-two times the threshold.
whatChanged.sharedStreams: A stream placed by more than one widget needing more than one mapping is COPIED rather than mutated, because mutating it would repair one placement by breaking the other. A stream that cannot be copied raises rather than being silently skipped. Neither case occurs in this family: streamsCopiedForConflictingPlacements is 0 on all three binaries.
